Algebra 1 · Unit 4: Linear Equations and Functions

Graphing Linear Equations

Graph lines from slope and intercept, from intercepts, or from a table.

What you’ll learn

  • Graph a line from its slope and y-intercept
  • Graph using x- and y-intercepts
  • Graph horizontal and vertical lines

The mountain biking connection

Graph two trails’ elevation models on the same axes to see which climbs faster.

Learning activities
